summary: An app shell with one module of two items and collapseShortPanel: only the rail shows, the page uses the full width.
use: Small modules (settings, profile) where a 200px panel would hold two links and leave the rest empty.
spec: `<AppShellLayout {modules} {pathname} collapseShortPanel persistPanel={false} mainId={null} skipLink={false}>` in a 320px tall frame
One module `id: 'settings'` (Settings icon) with two items: Profile and Billing
Page is `<PageShell title="Profile" description="A two-item module needs no panel: the rail is enough.">` with a glass `Card` hint
